principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages both the order items and the order status, while the PaymentProcessor handles payment processing, which are two distinct responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider separating the item management and order status responsibilities into different classes, such as OrderItemManager and OrderStatus.

principle_violations.reason: The Order and PaymentProcessor classes need to be modified for any new order or payment processing functionalities, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce interfaces or base classes for order and payment processing, allowing new functionalities to be added through subclasses without modifying existing code.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
